LanguageData.DSP_Barrel.label: Barrel
LanguageData.DSP_Barrel.description: A large barrel for storing copious amounts of liquid. You can only store one type of item in it at a time, because it's a barrel, and you're pouring liquid into it.
LanguageData.DSP_Bin.label: Bin
LanguageData.DSP_Bin.description: A large bin for storing a lot of one type of thing. On the plus side, it's faster to store things than a skip, since you don't need to arrange anything.
LanguageData.DSP_OrganFridge.label: Organ Fridge
LanguageData.DSP_OrganFridge.description:
A deep, insulated cold box for storing organs, prosthetics, and other body parts.
Note: because organs in Rimworld do not rot, this building does not require electricity.
LanguageData.DSP_WoodRack.label: Firewood Rack
LanguageData.DSP_WoodRack.description: A metal frame with a cover designed for storing firewood outside, without the wood getting wet.
